prompt: A seamlessly TILEABLE soft cloud/steam texture for a game weather overlay. Billowing white water-vapour, soft-edged, wispy, no hard outlines, no objects, no horizon, no text. Mostly white and very pale grey with a faint cool cyan tint in the deeper folds. Semi-transparent: dense white billows over large clear gaps, so a map drawn underneath still reads through it. Must tile edge-to-edge with no visible seam. Flat top-down, no perspective, no lighting direction.
style_notes: SCALD_STEAM_WEATHER_DESIGN_1 step 6 -- overlay texture A for RUT_WeatherOverlay_ScaldSteam (EnvironmentalHazards/Source). Install to src/RimMandrake/EnvironmentalHazards/Textures/Weather/RM_ScaldSteam_A.png. The class copies vanilla's Weather/FogOverlayWorld material and swaps _MainTex to this and _MainTex2 to the _b job; with the files absent it falls back to plain vanilla fog, so nothing breaks if only one lands. Vanilla's own fog overlay texture is the size/tiling/density reference -- extract it with the reading-rimworld-graphics skill before judging density. This is a TILING texture, NOT a sprite: no alpha silhouette, no centred subject, no outline.
